parrafo.es: Tally Trees retira arboles grandes y peligrosos en Tallahassee con grua propia. Sus clientes en Google destacan la rapidez: dos dias de espera para resolver un arbol que amenazaba su casa.
parrafo.en: Tally Trees takes down big, dangerous trees around Tallahassee with their own crane. Google reviewers point to the turnaround: a two day wait to handle a tree that threatened someone's home.

parrafo_1.es: Tally Trees retira y poda arboles en Tallahassee. Con grua, cargador y camion de canasta propios, resuelven trabajos que otras empresas tardan semanas en agendar.
parrafo_1.en: Tally Trees removes and trims trees around Tallahassee. With their own crane, loader and bucket truck, they take on jobs other companies take weeks to schedule.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google destacan precios justos (igualan cualquier cotizacion de la competencia) y trabajos que transforman arboles maltrechos en algo mas sano y presentable.
parrafo_2.en: Their Google reviewers point to fair pricing (they price match any other quote) and work that turns rough looking trees into something healthier and better looking.

items.quote: I am glad I hired Tally Trees. Not only did they price match any other tree companies quotes, they provided excellent service. They were quick and professional and I really enjoyed watching the tree removal.

Tally Trees managed to come remove a dangerous dead tree with the potential of destroying my home. Provided a low cost, high quality service with only a two day wait before they were able to take care of the tree.

Outstanding work on two oak trees. The trees were very rough looking, they performed a trim and lift service, cutting off all branches under a certain level, this gave them a clean appearance and even made the trees seem taller.

texto.es: Llamanos, cotizacion rapida y precios justos.
texto.en: Call us, fast quotes and fair pricing.

parrafo.es: Una llamada y agendamos rapido. Igualamos cualquier otra cotizacion.
parrafo.en: One call and we schedule fast. We price match any other quote.
